# hackerone_asset (Data Source)

Looks up an existing asset in an organization by its identifier, exposing its numeric `asset_id` for use with `hackerone_asset_scope`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) The asset identifier to look up (e.g. `example.com`). Must match an existing asset exactly.
- `organization_id` (String) Numeric ID of the organization that owns the asset.

### Read-Only

- `asset_id` (String) The bare numeric asset ID.
- `asset_type` (String) Asset type (e.g. `domain`, `url`, `wildcard`).
- `description` (String) Free-text description of the asset.
- `max_severity` (String) Maximum severity for findings on this asset.
- `reference` (String) Internal reference identifier for the asset.
